from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()

def tts(text: str, out: str = "{{output_path}}"):
    r = client.audio.speech.create(
        model="{{model_name}}",
        voice="{{voice_name}}",
        input=text,
    )
    with open(out, "wb") as f:
        f.write(r.read())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    tts("hello world")
